verdict.rationale: Copilot's own Browse with Copilot feature takes actions inside the Microsoft Edge browser, such as clicking, typing and navigating tabs. It runs locally, shows each step in real time, lets the user take control at any time, and asks for supervision on sensitive actions. That covers operating one application, but nothing shows it can see or operate other desktop applications. missing for 10: evidence of seeing and operating native desktop apps beyond Edge, detail on how Cowork carries out tasks on the computer, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can let the assistant see and operate applications on my computer to complete work

citations.quote: Browse with Copilot lets Copilot perform actions directly in your Microsoft Edge browser, such as clicking, typing, and navigating tabs.
You can see each step in real time and take control at any time. All actions run locally in your browser, ensuring full visibility and control.
Copilot will ask for your attention and supervision for certain actions, such as buying an item, booking a reservation, sending an email, or deleting a calendar event.
